title: introduce-rag-telemetry-presets-playground
author: Aisha Chen
release_notes: Add a lightweight RAG telemetry presets playground: examples, dashboards, and an agent shim that emits structured telemetry for caching, batching, tool-calls, and reranking. Useful for engineering teams to bootstrap production observability for RAG features.
body:
Title: introduce rag telemetry presets playground - a compact quickstart and examples set for RAG observability

Description: This PR adds a small, opinionated playground that demonstrates how to instrument Retrieval-Augmented Generation flows end-to-end with lightweight telemetry presets, example dashboards, and a developer-friendly agent shim. The goal is to make it trivial for application teams to collect consistent signals (latency by stage, cache/KV hits, batch sizes, reranker scores, tool call durations) and to provide curated Grafana/Prometheus snippets and example alert rules. This playground is intentionally small (single-node, file-backed index) and useful as a seed for both hosted and private deployments.

Why: We see repeated questions from customers and internal teams about how to measure RAG system health and regressions: token-level cost deltas, cache effectiveness, tool-call latencies causing tail latency, and search/rerank quality shifts. Providing a documented, runnable example reduces onboarding time and increases signal parity across teams. Related Linear: ENG-4211 (RAG telemetry baseline), PM-98 (RAG observability pilot).

What changed (high level):
- examples/rag-telemetry-playground/: new playground with README, devcontainer, and a small Node + Python agent shim that emits structured telemetry events to stdout/Prometheus exporter.
- examples/rag-telemetry-playground/dashboards/: Grafana JSON dashboard presets (compact, incident, and cost-focused views).
- docs/snippets/telemetry-presets.md: docs page describing the telemetry surface, recommended metrics, and alerting thresholds.
- examples/shared/telemetry-lib/: tiny library used by the playground to normalize event names and add redwood route/model metadata to emitted metrics.
- examples/rag-telemetry-playground/.github/workflows/smoke.yml: add an examples smoke CI job to validate the playground starts in CI.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add runnable example with minimal dependencies
- [x] Document telemetry signal names and semantics
- [x] Provide Grafana/Prometheus dashboard presets
- [x] Add CI smoke test to avoid regressions
- [x] Get review from SRE and RAG product leads

Commits (summary):
- 1a2b3c4: initial playground scaffold (README, devcontainer, example index)
- 2b3c4d5: telemetry-lib and structured event schema + example exporter
- 3c4d5e6: grafana dashboard presets and docs snippet
- 4d5e6f7: CI smoke workflow and small lint fixes after review

Changed files (illustrative):
- examples/rag-telemetry-playground/README.md (new)
- examples/rag-telemetry-playground/agent_shim/node_agent.js (new) - lightweight agent that issues generation requests and records stage timers
- examples/rag-telemetry-playground/agent_shim/py_exporter.py (new) - Prometheus exporter shim used in the dev playground
- examples/shared/telemetry-lib/schema.md (new) - event name and label conventions
- docs/snippets/telemetry-presets.md (new) - doc snippet for docs site
- examples/rag-telemetry-playground/dashboards/compact.json (new) - Grafana preset
- .github/workflows/smoke-examples.yml (modified) - add playground smoke job

Notes on implementation details:
- Metrics chosen: rag_request_latency_seconds (labels: stage=[retrieval, rerank, generation, tool_call], model, route, tenant), rag_cache_hit_ratio, rag_batch_size_histogram, rag_rerank_score_summary, rag_tool_call_duration_seconds, rag_token_cost_estimate (estimate per request). All metrics emitted with unit-aware names and consistent labels to enable cross-team dashboards.
- The agent shim simulates common RAG patterns: prefix caching, a two-stage retrieval + rerank, and optional external tool call (HTTP lookup). Each step emits start/stop events using the shared telemetry-lib so teams can trace where latency is added.
- Dashboard presets include templating by route and model name; cost view aggregates total estimated token cost vs cache ratio.
- The examples are intentionally dependency-light: the Node shim uses fetch and prints structured JSON events; the Python exporter uses prometheus_client library. The README includes Dockerfile and devcontainer for reproducible tests.

Review conversation (selection):
- Mateo Rivera (reviewer): "Great addition. Two asks: (1) can we include an example of correlating a request ID across stages? (2) the reranker score distribution should be a histogram rather than summary for percentile queries."
- Aisha Chen (author): "Thanks — added request_id propagation in the shim (now included in the telemetry-lib) and switched rerank_score to histogram. Also updated docs with an example promql query for p95 by stage."
- Sofia Patel (reviewer): "Please double-check label cardinality for 'model' on long-running dashboards. Maybe encourage using model_family or quantized flag as separate labels."
- Aisha Chen: "Good point — added guidance to docs/snippets/telemetry-presets.md recommending model_family and quantization labels and avoiding exposing full model version in high-cardinality dashboards."
- Evan Liu (SRE): "CI smoke run failed initially due to environment variables in the GH workflow. I pushed a tiny CI fix and re-ran — green now."

CI summary: 
- build: pass
- lint: pass (minor JS style fix applied)
- examples-smoke: pass (playground started and exporter returned metrics)
- docs-spellcheck: pass

Testing and validation: 
- Local: devcontainer reproducible run documented in README; run ./run_playground.sh starts the shim, the exporter, and opens the Grafana preset import instructions.
- CI: smoke job spins up the exporter and verifies endpoints /metrics and a sample dashboard JSON is parseable.

Migration/compat notes: 
- No breaking API changes. This is an additive example and docs-only change. Telemetry label conventions are recommended as best-practice; adoption is optional.

Follow-ups (future work): 
- Add an A/B test pattern for measuring quality vs cost with automated eval hooks.
- Provide a version that emits OpenTelemetry spans for use with tracing backends.
- Integrate a small evaluator that produces alerts on rerank distribution regressions.

Merge: Squash merged by Aisha Chen on 2026-03-03.

If you want to try this locally: see examples/rag-telemetry-playground/README.md for step-by-step instructions. The playground is intentionally simple — it should take under 10 minutes to run in a devcontainer and gives immediate dashboards for latency, cost, and cache effectiveness.
